name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.XState.stable
typeText:
∀ {m m' : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem} {V : List.{0} Nat} {st : Prod.{0, 0} Nat (Prod.{0, 0} Nat (List.{0} Nat))},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Agree m m' V →
    (∀ (x : Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} V x → LT.lt.{0} x DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN) →
      DisequalityDispersion.Machine.MDE ∉ V →
        DisequalityDispersion.Machine.CUR ∉ V →
          DisequalityDispersion.Machine.PATH ∉ V →
            LE.le.{0} 200 (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP) →
              DisequalityDispersion.Machine.XState st m → DisequalityDispersion.Machine.XState st m'

source.code:
theorem XState.stable {m m' : Mem} {V : List ℕ} {st : ℕ × ℕ × List ℕ} (hag : Agree m m' V)
    (hV : ∀ x, x ∈ V → x < IN) (hM : MDE ∉ V) (hC : CUR ∉ V) (hP : PATH ∉ V) (hhp : 200 ≤ m HP)
    (h : XState st m) : XState st m' :=
  ⟨by rw [hag.var MDE (lt_hp hhp (by decide)) (by decide) hM]; exact h.1,
    by rw [hag.var CUR (lt_hp hhp (by decide)) (by decide) hC]; exact h.2.1,
    h.2.2.stable hag hV (by addrf) (by addrf) hP⟩
